All other nav items (Home->首页, Performance Booking->表演邀约, Council->理事会, Join Us->加入我们) translate correctly, confirming the language context is working — only the brand span's ZH value is wrong.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx line 63, change `{t('UTeM 24FD', 'UTeM 24FD')}` to `{t('UTeM 24FD', '技大二十四节令鼓队')}`.
critical_code_review_comments: The intended change described in the request was not actually committed to Navbar.jsx — the ZH argument is still the English string.
